supervisor_summary: After round 2 the five forecasters agree NOK is fundamentally worth about $7.3-8.4 against a $10.975 close. My reconciled fair value is $8.13: 17.3x consistent-basis NTM P/E on EUR 0.41 blended with a EUR-rate DCF. The convergence is partly genuine: the agents' own segment work showed Nokia's Optical+IP deserves Cisco-like ~22x, not the ~26x I allowed in round 1. It is also partly anchoring on my round-1 DCF inputs, including a USD discount rate on EUR cash flows that I have now replaced with a EUR basis (8.09%). The ladder median is $9.45 (P(close >= $10.975) 0.39), between fair value and price, because the AI-optical premium has persisted all year and Q3 on 22 Oct is pre-guided. Defense is not separately disclosed (Mission Critical Enterprise & Defense customers are 9.3-9.9% of sales, an upper bound).
key_drivers: Earnings base: FY27 consensus EPS EUR 0.408 already implies about EUR 3.08bn comparable OP, near the top of the CMD 2028 range (EUR 2.7-3.2bn) a year early. Q4/FY26 results with the FY27 outlook (late Jan 2027) test it.
AI & Cloud: Q2 orders EUR 2.8bn with 'around half' expected to convert within 12 months (Q2 6-K); AI & Cloud sales +103% (+105% cc). Optical market +15% y/y, DCI +45% in 2Q26 (Dell'Oro).

Multiple: NOK at 24.8x NTM (6 Oct close $10.975) vs a 15.8x 10-peer median; segment mix justifies about 17.3x. The rest is AI-optical sentiment that trades with CIEN/ANET (+7.6% today, $10.20 -> $10.975 close, with no Nokia news).
